{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A silk slip dress, midi length, in a soft champagne hex #E8D5C4, woven from pure mulberry silk to catch the evening light.
Strappy sandals, ankle height, in a neutral tan hex #D2B48C, crafted from smooth leather with a modest heel for standing on grass.
A delicate gold necklace featuring pearl drops, color #FFD700, to serve as the focal point for her jewelry accent.

This outfit transitions gracefully from the outdoor ceremony in August heat to the restaurant dinner without requiring a heavy jacket or layers that would cause overheating. The champagne silk provides an elegant, formal silhouette suitable for a wedding guest while remaining breathable for summer weather. The gold pearl necklace honors her specific wish to highlight jewellery, adding a touch of noble refinement that matches the evening atmosphere."}
